summary.text: Randy Cowling is the Democratic candidate for Oklahoma State Senate District 2 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign described him as a journalist and, for 11 years, executive director of Owasso Community Resources.

paragraphs.text: Randy Cowling earned a high school diploma from Eureka High School and a degree from Southwest Baptist College in 1993, according to Ballotpedia, which lists him as retired.
His survey response says he holds a Bachelor of Arts from Southwest Baptist University and a Master of Divinity and Doctor of Ministry from Midwestern Baptist Theological Seminary.
It says he was managing editor of The Claremore Daily Progress and received the Oklahoma Press Association's Sequoyah Award before serving as executive director of Owasso Community Resources.
It also says he is married to Pamela Dunlap and has two adult daughters and six grandchildren.

In the survey, Cowling listed stronger schools with smarter spending, greater government transparency, and improving Oklahoma's rankings in education, poverty and domestic violence and tightening predatory loan practices as campaign priorities.
